string.text: Normally, the weapon will cycle upon letting go of the fire button. Enabling this will disable the cycling on fire keybind release and instead enables pressing the keybind below to cycle the weapon.
Turning this off will turn of the news message you get if you try to shoot or reload while the bolt hasn't been cycled.

With this enabled, pressing the zoom keybind while the weapon is cycling will put the key press into a queue, once the bolting is finished the zoom will be pressed automatically. Turning this off prevents this feature.
Enabling this will allow bolt action snipers to have fast anims when they have an rpm upgrade.
